source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
When this unit finishes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), you may pick 1 **visible** enemy unit that is within 12" of it and roll 1 D6: on a 3+, D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** are inflicted on that enemy unit.

Each unit can do this once per battle. Keep a Bomb Squig token beside the unit until the ability is used.

combat.unresolved: An independent review against the official text found this reading wrong or incomplete; it stays withheld until a fix is reviewed again.
